name: FAST-Splat
aliases: Fast, Ambiguity-Free Semantic Transfer in Gaussian Splatting
Fast, Ambiguity-Free Semantics Transfer in Gaussian Splatting
definition: A semantic Gaussian Splatting method that directly augments each Gaussian with specific semantic codes and uses a hash-table for disambiguation, avoiding neural fields for semantic distillation to enable fast training, rendering, and ambiguity-free object localization.
summary: FAST-Splat is a semantic Gaussian Splatting method that uses a hash-table for disambiguation, avoiding neural fields to enable fast training and ambiguity-free object localization.
